description.text: The tenth Scarlet & Violet set, released on 30 May 2025 with more than 240 cards, 182 before the secret rares. It brought back Team Rocket's Pokémon, more than 45 of them, with Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex under Giovanni, against heroes' Pokémon such as Cynthia's Garchomp ex, Ethan's Ho-Oh ex and Arven's Mabosstiff ex; Misty, Marnie and Steven have Pokémon in it too.
